name: Brittlebone

source.name: Libris Mortis: The Book of Undead

description_html:
Spread this unguent over bones before they are animated as a skeleton (a full-round action). The skeleton's natural armor drops by 2 (minimum 0). When it is destroyed, its bones burst: each creature within its reach takes 1 piercing damage per Hit Die of the skeleton (Reflex DC 15 half, minimum 1).

Craft (alchemy) DC 20. One flask covers one Medium or smaller target. A Large target needs 2 flasks, Huge 4, Gargantuan 8, and Colossal 16.

name: Bullet, Priest's

source.name: Libris Mortis: The Book of Undead

description_html:
A hollow glass sling bullet filled with holy water. On a hit it shatters and soaks the target. Undead and evil outsiders take an extra 1d4 damage. The bullet is oversized, so attacks with it take a -2 penalty. It does not affect incorporeal creatures unless the bullet also has ghost touch or a similar ability. Unholy versions exist and affect good outsiders the same way.

Craft (glassblowing) DC 15.

name: Embalming Fire

source.name: Libris Mortis: The Book of Undead

description_html:
Pour this liquid over a corpse and let it soak for at least 1 minute before the corpse is animated as a zombie. If that zombie later takes any damage, it burns with blue flame for 1 minute. The flame does not harm the zombie, but its attacks deal an extra 1d6 fire damage during that time. Spreading it is a full-round action.

Craft (alchemy) DC 20. One flask covers one Medium or smaller target. A Large target needs 2 flasks, Huge 4, Gargantuan 8, and Colossal 16.

name: Ghostoil

source.name: Libris Mortis: The Book of Undead

description_html:
Applied to a weapon, ghostoil lets that weapon affect incorporeal creatures normally for 2 rounds. Applying it is a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

Craft (alchemy) DC 25. One flask covers one Medium or smaller target. A Large target needs 2 flasks, Huge 4, Gargantuan 8, and Colossal 16.

name: Holy Water Sprinkler

source.name: Libris Mortis: The Book of Undead

description_html:
This heavy mace has a hollow head that holds 1 pint of holy or unholy water (eight splash uses). A hit also splashes the target for 1 damage to undead and evil outsiders (holy water) or to good outsiders (unholy water). The wielder can instead empty the reservoir on a hit: treat it as a direct hit with a flask (2d4 damage) and subtract 1 point for each use already spent. That hit has no splash. Filling the reservoir is a standard action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

It uses heavy mace weapon stats. Craft (weaponsmithing) DC equals the DC to craft the weapon, +5.

name: Liquid Night

source.name: Libris Mortis: The Book of Undead

description_html:
This dark fluid lets a daylight-sensitive undead ignore vulnerability to sunlight for 1 hour. A spell or effect that would deal extra damage because of sunlight vulnerability treats the creature as if it lacked that vulnerability, and then burns the coating away. It smells of moonflower. Spreading it is a full-round action.

Craft (alchemy) DC 25. One flask covers one Medium or smaller target. A Large target needs 2 flasks, Huge 4, Gargantuan 8, and Colossal 16.

name: Gravedust

source.name: Libris Mortis: The Book of Undead

description_html:
Contact positoxin, Fortitude DC 10. Initial damage 1 Dexterity drain. Secondary damage 1d4 Dexterity drain. One dose costs 100 gp. Craft (alchemy) DC 20.

A positoxin affects corporeal undead only and is harmless to other creatures, including incorporeal undead. It does not work in an antimagic field. Treat it as a poison for detect poison, delay poison, and neutralize poison. Ability loss cannot reduce a score below 1 unless the entry says otherwise. A corporeal undead that applies a positoxin has a 5% chance to expose itself. On a natural 1 attack roll with a coated weapon, that undead must succeed on a DC 15 Reflex save or poison itself. A character who can handle poison safely ignores those risks. Creating one also requires the ability to channel positive energy, or help from someone who can.

name: Bloodwine

source.name: Libris Mortis: The Book of Undead

A living creature can drink a dose; it stays in the blood for 12 hours. An undead that drains that blood must save as if injured by the positoxin, but the DC is 9. One dose costs 250 gp.
